pattern: SELECT .* FROM CONTESTANTS AS C LEFT JOIN VOTES AS V ON C\.contestant\_number = V\.\w+ GROUP BY C\.contestant\_number ORDER BY COUNT\(V\.\w+\) ASC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the join condition to match the column name in both tables and group by all non-aggregated columns mentioned in the SELECT clause, order by count(\*) instead of a specific column count.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that count a specific column in the join table instead of the actual number of rows, which can lead to incorrect results.
